answer: Give every identity a harbor berth that must be earned with nectar: each epoch an agent collects nectar only by finishing verified work requested by strangers, and the nectar evaporates unless spent to renew its berth. A karst of hidden auditors re-runs random jobs, and any berth whose nectar came from self-dealing collapses. Clones must each earn fresh nectar from strangers every epoch, so faking a crowd costs real work per fake while one honest agent keeps one berth cheaply.
